title: Wispy Clinches Third Straight NRRS Chase Berth at Martinsville
summary: A P4 finish in the Goody's Fast Relief 500 locked Wispy and the #32 Aetherwing entry into the NRRS Season 3 Chase, marking a third consecutive NRRS postseason appearance and fifth confirmed Chase qualification overall.

title: Michigan Photo Finish For Rowdy
summary: Nicholas Waggoner won the NASCAR iRacing Series race at Michigan by 0.029 seconds in the #28 Cheddar’s Toyota, adding another verified Aetherwing victory.

title: Michigan Truck Victory Marks 25
summary: Nicholas Waggoner followed the Michigan NIS win with an iRacing Trucks victory, giving Aetherwing its 25th recorded team win.

title: Waggoner Wins the Indianapolis 500 on iRacing
summary: Nicholas Waggoner delivered a crown-jewel victory for Aetherwing, winning the Indianapolis 500 on iRacing.

title: Aetherwing Sweeps the Clashes
summary: Aetherwing opened the 2026 RoRacing season with a two-league statement as Jaxon won the NRRS Clash and Jayden completed the sweep with a UARL Clash victory.

title: BellSouth Becomes Aetherwing
summary: BellSouth eMotorsports became Aetherwing eMotorsports, launching the current identity while carrying forward the verified modern competition record.

title: Wispy Scores First RoRacing Win
summary: Wispy broke through in the NRRS Season 2 All-Star Race at Miami for the first RoRacing victory of the recorded career.

title: Aetherwing Scores 1–2 in Kmart Cup Daytona 500
summary: Flamingo won the Season 1 Daytona 500 with teammate Will pushing him to the line, producing Aetherwing’s first points-paying victory and a historic 1–2 finish.
